verdict.rationale: Superset is described as local-first — 'it works offline... your code never leaves your machine unless you say so' — and the CLI/backend can be run as a 'local host server' driving the same backend as the desktop app, which effectively means the core product already runs on infrastructure you control rather than a vendor SaaS. However there is no explicit self-hosting/deployment guide (e.g., Docker, server install docs) for the multi-user 'remote access' host component, and the hosted MCP server/API endpoints (api.superset.sh) suggest a vendor-hosted component exists alongside the local app. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting deployment documentation for the remote/multi-user host server, confirmation of open-source licensing for the full backend, and evidence of self-hosting the hosted MCP/API surface.
